task: 새로 들어온 영업 담당자가 메일함을 연결하면 지난 메일도 CRM에 들어오게 해줘. 지금은 연결한 뒤에 온 메일만 들어와서 처음엔 CRM이 텅 비어 있어.
hidden_context: This is the company's own install of the CRM, one workspace. apps/api, apps/app and apps/agent run on Vercel Pro; Postgres is a 10 GB plan with 2.4 GB used.
There are 14 reps. 12 use Google Workspace and 2 use Microsoft 365 (Outlook) since an acquisition in August. Three new reps start next month, then about one a month.
A rep's mailbox holds 3 to 6 years of mail, 30,000 to 150,000 messages. Sales wants the last 12 months, because the sales cycle is 6 to 9 months; older mail is noise to them.
A new rep should see their history within a day or two of connecting; nobody needs it within minutes.

The Context plan is 25,000 credits a month and about 19,000 are used. A 12-month backfill of one rep's mailbox would bring in roughly 800 to 1,500 new contacts. The founder does not want the monthly bill to rise for this feature.

Reps' work mailboxes also hold recruiting threads with candidates, personal threads, and threads with outside legal counsel. At onboarding, reps were promised that only mail with customers and prospects enters the CRM, and legal asks that Gmail threads labelled 'Private' never enter. These rules are requirements for this feature; changing the forward sync is out of scope.

A workspace-scope team agent reacts to every contact.created event: it posts the new contact to the #new-leads Slack channel and creates a follow-up task for the owner. The sales manager reads #new-leads every morning.
Next quarter two partner companies will self-host the CRM with docker compose and a system cron that calls the internal endpoints once an hour; they want the same backfill.
